duration.text: The Clinical Medicine at Southern Medical University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5694 USD/per year ￥ 41000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Scanned copy of the information page of the valid passport2 Highest academic degree certificate. Fresh graduates should submit the expected graduation certificate (original scanned copy and English translation). After being pre-admitted, fresh graduates must submit their academic degree certificates to obtain the admission qualification.3 Transcripts of all courses in the highest academic education stage (original scanned copies and English translations)4. Study Plan in China Written in Chinese (for those applying for programs taught in Chinese) or English (for those applying for programs taught in English); The content includes personal study and work experiences, academic research achievements, research plans during the master's or doctoral stage, further education plans, and personal development goals after graduation, etc. Master's students should have no less than 1,000 words and doctoral students no less than 1,500 words.5 Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors, which must be original in either Chinese or English (including signatures and contact information)6. Pre-admission letter from the Supervisor of Southern Medical University7. A list of published papers, abstracts, or other materials that can prove one's research ability8. Id photo (2-inch bareheaded photo with a blue background)9 Self-introduction video in English or Chinese (3-5 minutes, no more than 50M)10. A scanned copy of the "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners" (please keep the original for yourself), which must be filled out in either Chinese or English.11. Proof of language proficiency12. Scanned copies of the "International Student Financial Guarantee Form" and its guarantee materials, which must be filled out in either Chinese or English, and provide a deposit certificate sufficient to cover reasonable expenses such as study, living, and international travel during their study in China (the deposit amount should be no less than 150,000 RMB). And a scanned copy of the passport or identity document of the financial guarantor (only a relative of the applicant) (to be provided by applicants for self-funded projects)

requirements.text: 1. Not of Chinese nationality but holding a valid foreign passport. And there is a record of having actually resided abroad for more than two years within the last four years (up to April 30 of the admission year).2. Be in good physical and mental health and meet the physical examination standards for applying for a study visa or residence permit to China.3. Age and educational requirements:Undergraduate students: Under 30 years old, with an educational qualification equivalent to a high school diploma in China.(2) Master's degree candidates: Under 35 years old, with a degree equivalent to a bachelor's degree from a Chinese university.(3) Doctoral candidates: Under 40 years old, with a degree equivalent to a master's degree from a Chinese university.4. Diligent and eager to learn, with good conduct, abiding by laws and regulations, no record of violating school rules and regulations, no record of public security penalties, and no criminal record.5. Excellent academic performance and a clear purpose for studying in China. Applicants for master's or doctoral degrees are required to have a GPA of 3.0 or above in their previous academic stage, with no failed or retaken subjects. For undergraduate applicants, the average grade of the three years of high school must be above 75%, with no failed subjects.6. Have good language skills in either Chinese or English. The specific requirements are as follows:(1) Undergraduate programs taught in Chinese: A score certificate of HSK Level 4 (no less than 180 points) or other equivalent Chinese proficiency test results is required. Applicants whose highest academic degree was taught entirely in Chinese are exempt from the Chinese language test score certificate, but they must submit a Chinese language teaching certificate issued by their graduating school.(2) Undergraduate programs taught in English: Applicants whose native language is not English must have proof of IELTS Academic (no less than 6.0, with no less than 5.5 in each section), TOEFL (IBT no less than 80, with no less than 15 in each section), or other equivalent English test scores. Applicants whose native language is English or whose highest academic degree was taught entirely in English may be exempted from the English test score certificate, but they must submit a certificate of English teaching issued by their graduating school.(3) Postgraduate programs taught in Chinese: A score certificate of HSK Level 5 (no less than 180 points) or other equivalent Chinese proficiency tests is required.(4) English-taught postgraduate programs: Applicants whose native language is not English must provide proof of IELTS Academic (with no less than 6.5 in each section and no less than 6.0 in each section), TOEFL (with no less than 90 in IBT and no less than 20 in each section), or other equivalent English test scores. Applicants whose native language is English or whose highest academic degree was taught entirely in English may be exempted from the English test score certificate, but they must submit a certificate of English teaching issued by their graduating school.7. Did not receive the Chinese Government Scholarship simultaneously.
